---
name: Accessibility (a11y) Issue
about: Report screen reader, keyboard navigation, or contrast issues
title: '[A11Y] '
labels: accessibility, a11y
assignees: ''
---

**Accessibility Category**
- [ ] Screen Reader Semantics (ARIA labels, headings, announcements)
- [ ] Keyboard Navigation (Tab order, focus rings, shortcut keys)
- [ ] Color Contrast (Dark mode / Light mode text readability)
- [ ] Reduced Motion (Confetti or animated transitions)
- [ ] Touch Targets (Button or checkbox sizing on mobile devices)

**Where is the issue observed?**
- URL or View: [e.g. Today Dashboard, Settings Dialog, Full Plan]
- Assistive Tech / Environment: [e.g. TalkBack, VoiceOver, NVDA, Keyboard only]

**Current Behavior:**
A clear description of what happens and why it creates a barrier for assistive technology or keyboard users.

**Expected Accessible Behavior:**
How the element or screen should behave to conform with WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.

**Proposed Fix (if known):**
[Code snippet or suggestion]
